Name: Poppy Seed Chicken (Gayle's Version)
Ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. chicken or 4 to 5 chicken breasts, boiled; 1 can cream of celery soup; 1 small sour cream; 1 stick butter; 3 Tbsp. poppy seed; 1 can cream of mushroom soup; 1 pkg. almonds; Ritz crackers
Instructions: 1. Cook and debone chicken. 2. Mix with soups, sour cream, and almonds. 3. Melt butter and crumble crackers until all butter is taken up. 4. Top casserole with this and sprinkle with poppy seed. 5. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

Name: Lemon Garlic Chicken
Ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about 1-1/4 lbs.); 1/4 cup flour; 2 Tbsp. I Can't Believe It's Not Butter Spread; 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Savory Herb with Garlic Soup Mix; 1-3/4 cups water; 2 Tbsp. lemon juice
Instructions: 1. Dip chicken in flour, shaking off excess. In 12-inch nonstick skillet, melt Spread over medium-high heat and brown chicken, turning once. 2. Stir in Soup Mix blended with water and lemon juice. 3. Reduce heat & simmer covered 5 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked.

Name: Herbed Chicken & Vegetables
Ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, thinly sliced (about 1 lb.); 2 medium carrots, sliced; 4 bone-in chicken breast halves (about 2 lbs.); 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Savory Herb with Garlic Soup Mix; 1/3 cup water; 1 Tbsp. Bertolli Olive Oil
Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°. In broiler pan without rack, add potatoes and carrots; top with chicken. 2. Pour Soup Mix blended with water and olive oil over chicken and vegetables. 3. Bake uncovered 40 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked and vegetables are tender.

Name: Chicken & Dumplings
Ingredients: 4 c breast or whole chicken; Salt & pepper; Stick of butter; Water; About 3 C flour for dumplings
Instructions: 1. Cook chicken til done with salt, pepper, stick of butter, and water (cook slow). 2. Save broth for dumplings. 3. Debone & cut chicken. 4. Mix flour & water for dumplings. 5. Roll out flat & cut in strips. 6. Drop in broth. 7. Do not stir - pat down with spoon to keep under broth til done. 8. Then add chicken.

Name: Poppy Seed Chicken (Chanda's Version)
Ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, boiled and cut into pieces; 2 Tbsp. poppy seed; 1½ rolls Ritz crackers, crushed; 2 cans cream of chicken soup; 16 oz. sour cream; 1½ sticks oleo
Instructions: 1. Melt oleo. 2. Combine soups and sour cream. 3. Add poppy seed and chicken. 4. Pour chicken mixture into a casserole dish. 5. Pour oleo over crackers and top chicken. 6. Sprinkle a little more poppy seed on top. 7. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes, until bubbly.
Notes: This can be made the night before.

Name: Easy Chicken & Cheese Enchiladas
Ingredients: 1 can (10¾ oz.) Campbell's Condensed Cream of Chicken Soup; ½ cup sour cream; 1 cup Pace Picante Sauce; 2 tsp. chili powder; 2 cups chopped cooked chicken; ½ cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese; 6 flour tortillas (6"), warmed; 1 small tomato, chopped; 1 green onion, sliced
Instructions: 1. Stir the soup, sour cream, picante sauce and chili powder in a medium bowl. 2. Stir 1 cup picante sauce mixture, chicken and cheese in a large bowl. 3. Divide the chicken mixture among the tortillas. Roll up the tortillas and place them seam-side up in an 11x8" shallow baking dish. Pour the remaining picante sauce mixture over the filled tortillas. Cover the baking dish. 4. Bake at 350°F for 40 min. or until the enchiladas are hot and bubbling. Top with the tomato and onion.

Name: Poppy Seed Chicken (Mary Katherine's Version)
Ingredients: 12 chicken breasts, boiled; 2 tubes Ritz crackers; 1½ pt. sour cream; 4 oz. cream cheese; 1 stick butter; Poppy seed; 2 cans cream of chicken soup
Instructions: 1. Chop chicken in dish; pour soup mixture over. 2. Crumble 2 tubes Ritz crackers on top of this. 3. Pour stick of melted butter on crackers. 4. Put poppy seed on top. 5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

Name: Crescent Roll Chicken
Ingredients: 3 chicken breasts; 2 crescent rolls; 12 oz Taco cheese; 1 can Cream of Chicken soup; 1 can milk
Instructions: 1. Boil chicken & chop. 2. Unroll crescent and put chicken & cheese inside. 3. Roll back up. 4. Mix soup & milk together. 5. Pour over rolls, top with cheese. 6. Bake 375° until lightly browned.

Name: Cheesy Garlic Chicken
Ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about 1-1/4 lbs.); 1 medium tomato, coarsely chopped; 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Savory Herb; 1/8 cup water; 1 Tbsp. Bertolli Olive Oil; ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese; 1 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, arrange chicken; top with tomato. 2. Pour Soup Mix blended with water and olive oil over chicken. 3. Bake 20 minutes. Top with cheeses and bake 5 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked.

Name: Parmesan Chicken
Ingredients: 12 boneless chicken breast; 2 stacks Ritz crackers (crushed); Melted butter; Parmesan cheese; Salt & pepper
Instructions: 1. Soak chicken in butter. 2. Roll in crushed crackers. 3. Place in 9x13 dish. 4. Sprinkle with salt & pepper. 5. Cover with Parmesan cheese. 6. Bake at 375° for about 45 min.

Name: Gunk
Ingredients: 1 lb hamburger; ½ bell pepper; ½ onion; 1 pkg egg noodles; 1 can cream corn; 1 can English peas; 1 can tomato soup; 2 cans tomato sauce; 3 T Worcestershire sauce; Salt & pepper; Grated cheese
Instructions: 1. Brown 1 lb hamburger, add ½ bell pepper & ½ onion. Cook till done. 2. Cook 1 pkg egg noodles, drain. Set aside. 3. Mix cream corn, English peas, tomato soup, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt & pepper. 4. Layer (start with noodles), meat, cheese, ½ c sauce. 5. Top with cheese & Bake.

Name: Sour Cream Potato Salad
Ingredients: 8 medium potatoes; 1½ c. mayonnaise; 1½ tsp. horseradish; ½ tsp. salt; 1 c. parsley, minced; 2 medium onions, minced; 1 c. sour cream; 1 Tbsp. celery seed
Instructions: 1. Boil potatoes in salt water. Peel and slice thinly. 2. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, horseradish, celery seed, and salt. 3. Combine parsley and onion. 4. In serving dish, arrange layers of potatoes, mayonnaise mixture, and onion mixture. 5. Refrigerate.

Name: Holiday Sweet Potatoes
Ingredients: ½ c. margarine; 6 to 8 sweet potatoes, cooked, peeled, and sliced; 1 tsp. baking powder; 1 tsp. vanilla; 1 tsp. cinnamon; 2 eggs; ¾ c. sugar; ¾ c. buttermilk; ¾ c. pecans (optional); Marshmallows
Instructions: 1. Add margarine to hot potatoes. 2. Combine with 6 ingredients with mixer. 3. Place mixture in greased 2 quart casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. 4. Top with marshmallows during the last 10 minutes of cooking.

Name: Simple Sausage Balls
Ingredients: 3 c Bisquick; 1 lb cheese; 1 lb sausage
Instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into balls and bake at 350° until golden brown (about 20-25 minutes).

Name: Oven-Roasted Vegetables
Ingredients: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets Savory Herb with Garlic Soup Mix; 1-1/2 lbs. assorted fresh vegetables (zucchini, yellow squash, bell peppers, carrots, celery, onions, mushrooms); 2 Tbsp. Bertolli Olive Oil
Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 450°. In 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan, combine all ingredients. 2. Bake uncovered, stirring once, 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

Name: Nanny's Candied Sweet Potatoes
Ingredients: Sweet potatoes; 2 C sugar; ½ t vanilla; ½ t cinnamon; Butter; White Karo; Water (about ¼ c or ½ c)
Instructions: 1. Boil, drain potatoes. 2. Mix & cook: sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, butter, White Karo. 3. Add just enough water to cook.

Name: Sweet Potato Casserole
Ingredients: 3 c. mashed potatoes; 1 c. sugar; 1 stick oleo; 2 eggs; 1 Tbsp. vanilla; ½ c. raisins (optional); Topping: 1 c. brown sugar, 1 c. chopped pecans, 1/3 c. flour, 1/3 c. butter melted
Instructions: 1. Mix all together and put in a buttered casserole dish. 2. For topping: Mix till crumbly and sprinkle on top of potatoes. 3. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

Name: Sausage-Cheese Balls
Ingredients: 3 cups Original Bisquick Baking Mix; 1 lb uncooked bulk pork sausage; 4 cups shredded cheddar cheese; ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese; ½ cup milk; ½ teaspoon dried rosemary leaves, crushed; 1½ teaspoons chopped fresh parsley; Barbecue sauce or chili sauce for dipping (optional)
Instructions: 1. Heat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease bottom and sides of 2 rimmed 15x10x1-inch baking pans. 2. In large bowl, stir together all ingredients except barbecue sauce, using hands or spoon. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place ½ inch apart on pans. 3. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, rotating pans halfway through bake time, until brown. Immediately remove from pan; transfer to serving platter. Serve warm with sauce for dipping.

Name: Roasted Turkey
Ingredients: 1 whole turkey; Olive oil; Dry mustard; Vinegar; Celery; Onion; Butter; Bacon strips; Clean cloth/rag
Instructions: 1. Make paste of olive oil, dry mustard & vinegar. 2. Place rag (soaked in olive oil) over turkey & refrigerate overnight. 3. Stuff with celery and onion. 4. Place butter under each wing and dampen rag with olive oil. 5. Place three strips of bacon over breast. 6. Bake 350° for 5 to 6 hours.

Name: Cheese & Macaroni
Ingredients: 12 cups cooked macaroni (drained); 1 pkg. red rind hoop cheese (grated); 2 beaten eggs; 4 tablespoons butter (heaping); Salt & Pepper; Milk (enough to float macaroni & cheese)
Instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake 350° until almost firm, about 1 hour.

Name: Cocktail Meatballs
Ingredients: 1 (12 oz) jar chili sauce; 1 small jar grape jelly; 1 lb. ground chuck
Instructions: 1. Heat chili sauce and stir in grape jelly, until dissolved and blended. 2. Shape the meat into small balls. 3. Brown meatballs and pour off fat. 4. Place meatballs in sauce mixture and simmer for 20 minutes, uncovered.

Name: Peach Salad
Ingredients: 1 c. miniature marshmallows; 1 small can crushed pineapple; 1 can coconut; 1 small ctn. sour cream; 1 large can peach halves, drained
Instructions: 1. Mix marshmallows, pineapple, coconut, and sour cream. 2. Spoon into peach halves. 3. Cover and chill overnight.

Name: Grape Salad
Ingredients: 2½ to 3 lb. seedless grapes (whole); 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese; ½ c. confectioners sugar; ½ tsp. vanilla flavoring; 8 oz. sour cream; ½ c. brown sugar; ½ c. chopped pecans
Instructions: 1. Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar, and vanilla flavoring in mixer till smooth. 2. Fold in sour cream. 3. Add whole grapes, which have been removed from stems, washed, and well drained; do not chop grapes. 4. Spoon into 9x13 inch pan. 5. Mix brown sugar and nuts with fork. Spread over grape mixture. 6. Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

Name: Parmesan Salad
Ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli (2 to 3 stalks); 1 head cauliflower; 1 medium onion, finely chopped; 1 c. mayonnaise; ¼ c. Parmesan cheese; ¼ c. sugar (optional); Salad toppings or bacon bits
Instructions: 1. Break broccoli and cauliflower into tiny flowerets (bite-size). Thinly slice stem portions. 2. Combine with onion and salad toppings. 3. Mix mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, and sugar. Toss with salad. 4. Seal tightly and chill. The longer it chills, the better the seasonings taste.
Notes: For more color, use purple onion instead of white. Serves 6 to 8.

Name: Broccoli Salad
Ingredients: 3 c. broccoli florets; 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled; ½ c. purple onion, chopped; ¼ c. shelled sunflower seeds; 1 c. mayonnaise; 2 Tbsp. wine vinegar; ¼ c. sugar; Cherry tomatoes (optional, per handwritten note)
Instructions: 1. Toss together first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. 2. Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, and sugar; pour over broccoli mixture and toss well. 3. Chill thoroughly before serving.
Notes: Add cherry tomatoes for extra color (per handwritten addition).

Name: Dried Beef Ball
Ingredients: 1 jar dried beef; 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese; 4 or 5 green onions, chopped; Accent seasoning; Chopped pecans (about ½ cup)
Instructions: 1. Chop beef and mix with softened cream cheese. 2. Add onions and season with Accent. 3. Roll into ball, then roll ball in chopped pecans. 4. Chill and serve with favorite crackers.

Name: Ole Hor D'oeuvres
Ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened; 1 (8 oz.) pkg. sour cream; 1 large pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese; 1 large jar mild picante sauce; 1 can diced tomatoes, drained; 1 small bunch chopped green onions; 1 pkg. ham slices, chopped; 1 small can black olives, sliced; 1 large pkg. Doritos or Tostitos
Instructions: 1. Mix cream cheese and sour cream until well blended. Spread into lipped tray. 2. Layer picante sauce, ham, onions, tomatoes, Cheddar cheese, and top with olives. 3. Dip with Doritos or Tostitos.

Name: Nanny's Green Jello Salad
Ingredients: 2 boxes green Jello (cooked); Large can crushed pineapple; ¾ cup mayonnaise; ¼ cup crushed pineapple; 1 lg cottage cheese; 8 oz pecans; ½ cream cheese
Instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate until set.

Name: Good Frozen Fruit Salad
Ingredients: 4 bananas, mashed; Large can crushed pineapple; 1½ c. sugar; 1½ c. pecans; 1 c. sour cream; 9 oz. Cool Whip; ½ c. chopped cherries
Instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill (or freeze).

Name: Company Fruit Salad
Ingredients: 4 medium Golden apples, diced; 4 medium Red Delicious apples, diced; 2 c. green grapes, halved; 2 c. red grapes, halved; 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drained
Instructions: Toss all of the above. Beat dressing until smooth, pour over fruit, toss to coat. Serve immediately.

Name: Fiesta Dip
Ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) fat-free cream cheese, softened; 1 can Ro-Tel (mild or hot)
Instructions: Beat cream cheese to blending consistency. Add Ro-Tel and mix well. Serve with favorite chip.

Name: Cheese Straws
Ingredients: 2 (6 oz) wedges of extra sharp cheese; 2 sticks of butter (room temperature); 3 cups Wondra flour; ½ teaspoon Red Pepper
Instructions: 1. Grate cheese. 2. Mix with butter that is room temperature. 3. Use hands to mix well. 4. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 min.

Name: Strawberry-Fig Preserves
Ingredients: 6 c mashed figs; 7 c sugar; 2 (6 oz) boxes strawberry jello; 1 box Sure Jell
Instructions: 1. Cook figs and sugar until sugar is melted. 2. Add jello, sure jell and cook for 5 minutes. 3. Put in jars and seal.

Name: Chex Muddy Buddies
Ingredients: 1 cup semisweet chocolate chips; ½ cup peanut butter; ¼ cup butter or margarine; 1 teaspoon vanilla; 9 cups Rice Chex, Corn Chex or Honey Nut Chex cereal; 1½ cups powdered sugar
Instructions: 1. In 1-quart microwavable bowl, mix chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter. 2. Microwave uncovered on High 1 minute; stir. 3. Microwave 30 seconds longer or until mixture can be stirred smooth. 4. Stir in vanilla. 5. Place cereal in large bowl. 6. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal, stirring until evenly coated. 7. Pour into 2-gallon plastic food-storage bag. Add powdered sugar. 8. Seal bag; shake until well coated. 9. Spread on waxed paper until cooled. 10. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

Name: Best Boiled Peanuts
Ingredients: 2 lb. dried raw peanuts; ¾ cup salt
Instructions: 1. Soak peanuts in water to cover in a large stock pot at least 8 hours or up to 24 hours (weigh down with plate or lid). Drain and rinse. 2. Place peanuts and salt in stock pot with 4½ qt. water; reduce heat to medium-low and cook 6 hours or until peanuts are tender, adding water as needed; stir occasionally. 3. Remove from heat; let stand 1 hour.
Notes: For Cajun Boiled Peanuts: Use ½ cup salt and add ½ cup Cajun seasoning. Prep: 15 min, Soak: 8 hr, Cook: 6 hr. Makes 14 cups.

Name: Chex Barbecue Snack Mix
Ingredients: 3 cups Rice Chex cereal; 3 cups Corn Chex cereal; 1½ cups pretzel twists; 1½ cups bite-size cheese crackers; ¾ cup honey-roasted peanuts; ½ cup barbecue sauce; 1 tablespoon vegetable oil; ¾ teaspoon onion powder; ¾ teaspoon garlic powder
Instructions: 1. In large microwavable bowl, mix cereals, pretzels, crackers and peanuts. 2. In small bowl, stir together remaining ingredients. Pour over cereal mixture, stirring until evenly coated. 3. Microwave uncovered on High 7 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. 4. Spread on waxed paper to cool. Store in airtight container.
Notes: Makes 7½ cups snack. Prep: 10 min, Total: 30 min.

Name: Sarah's Pear Preserves
Ingredients: 1 gal. blended pears; 5 lbs. sugar; 2 cans crushed pineapple
Instructions: 1. Cook pears & pineapple until hot, stir in sugar. 2. Cook til syrup. 3. Cook lids. 4. Put on hot jars.

Name: Shrimp Dip
Ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise; 1 cup sour cream; 1/3 cup chopped green pepper; 1/4 cup chili sauce; 2 cups cooked shrimp or 2 cans tiny shrimp; Salt & Pepper to taste
Instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

Name: Cheese Ball
Ingredients: 16 oz. can fruit cocktail (mashed); 16 oz. cream cheese; 1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding; 1 tbsp. orange juice; Pecans for rolling; Graham crackers for serving
Instructions: 1. Sprinkle instant pudding mix over cream cheese and mix. 2. Add mashed fruit cocktail and orange juice. 3. Roll into one big ball or two small ones. 4. Chill and then roll in pecans. 5. Serve with graham crackers.

Name: Pecan Pie (BD's - Makes 2)
Ingredients: 4 eggs; 1 C white Karo; 1 c sugar; 2 T butter; 1 t vanilla; 1½ c chopped pecans; 2 unbaked pie shells
Instructions: 1. Mix all ingredients together. 2. Pour in unbaked shells. 3. Cook 350° about 45 min.

Name: Pecan Pie
Ingredients: ½ c. melted oleo; 1 c. sugar; 1 c. light corn syrup; 4 eggs, beaten; 1 (9 inch) unbaked pie shell; 1 tsp. vanilla; ¼ tsp. salt; 1 c. pecan halves
Instructions: 1. Combine oleo, sugar, and corn syrup. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved. Cool. 2. Add eggs, vanilla, and salt. Mix well. 3. Pour filling into pie shell and top with pecans. 4. Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes.

Name: Chocolate Pie
Ingredients: 1½ c. sugar; 3 Tbsp. cocoa; 3 Tbsp. flour; Butter (size of large egg); 4 egg yolks, beaten; 1½ c. milk; 1½ tsp. vanilla; Baked pie shell; Meringue (egg whites + 6 Tbsp sugar)
Instructions: 1. In top of double boiler, mix dry ingredients. Add next three ingredients and mix well. 2. Cook until thick, about 15 minutes, stirring often. Add vanilla. 3. Pour into a baked pie shell. 4. Spread with meringue made of egg whites and 6 tablespoons sugar. 5. Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown.
Notes: Microwave method: Mix ingredients as instructed and microwave on HIGH for 2 minutes; remove and beat with wire whip. Microwave 2 minutes. Beat and then microwave 2 additional minutes. Beat and pour into baked pie shell. Add meringue.

Name: Buttermilk Pie
Ingredients: 1-¾ c. sugar; 2 T. flour; 3 eggs; 1 stick oleo, melted; ½ c. buttermilk; 2 tsp. vanilla; Unbaked pie shell
Instructions: 1. Beat eggs; add flour and sugar, and stir together until well mixed. 2. Add milk, vanilla, and oleo; mix well. 3. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake 325° for 45 minutes.

Name: Lemon Ice Box Pie
Ingredients: Crust: Vanilla wafers (crushed in bottom, whole ones around side), 2 T sugar, 2 T butter melted; Filling: Juice of 3 lemons (¼ cup), 6 T sugar, 1 can Eagle Brand, 2 egg yolks; Topping: 2 egg whites, ¼ t cream of tartar, ¼ C sugar, ½ t vanilla
Instructions: 1. For crust: Crush wafers in bottom of pie pan, place whole ones around side, sprinkle with sugar, pour melted butter over bottom. 2. For filling: Mix egg yolks, milk, sugar together, add lemon juice. Pour over crust. 3. For topping: Beat egg whites first then add other ingredients. Spread on pie. 4. Cook til top lightly browned.

Name: Egg Pie
Ingredients: ¾ sticks butter; 1 cup evaporated milk; Pinch salt; 1 cup sugar; 2 tablespoons flour; 1 teaspoon vanilla; 4 eggs; 1 cup sweet milk; 2 unbaked pie shells
Instructions: 1. Put on stove after mixed. 2. Heat until butter melts (stir constantly). 3. Pour in unbaked pie shell. 4. Cook 350° until set.

Name: Chess Pie
Ingredients: 2 sticks butter; 1 C sugar; 6 eggs; 4 T corn meal; 4 T vinegar; 2 t vanilla; Unbaked pie shell
Instructions: Mix together & Bake until brown at 350°.

Name: Chocolate Chip Pie
Ingredients: 1 c. chocolate chips; 1-1/2 c. sugar; 2 eggs; 1 T. vanilla flavoring; 1 T. flour; 1 T. margarine or butter; ½ c. milk
Instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 300 degrees for about an hour or until pie starts to brown on top.

Name: Butterfinger Pie
Ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese, softened; 8 oz. Cool Whip, thawed; 1 c. crushed Butterfinger; 1 graham cracker pie shell
Instructions: Stir together cream cheese and Cool Whip until combined. Pour in pie shell and chill.

Name: Chocolate Chess Pie
Ingredients: 1 stick oleo; 1½ c. sugar; 1 Tbsp. flour; 2 Tbsp. cocoa; 3 eggs; 1 tsp. vanilla; ¼ c. milk; Unbaked pie shell
Instructions: 1. Melt oleo. In a separate pan, mix sugar, flour, and cocoa. Pour into oleo. 2. Stir to mix. Add eggs, one at a time. Stir after each egg. 3. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. 4. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

Name: Chocolate Pecan Pie
Ingredients: 2 eggs, slightly beaten; 1 c. sugar; ½ c. self-rising flour; 1 stick oleo, melted; 1 c. pecans; 6 oz. chocolate chips; Unbaked pie shell
Instructions: 1. Combine oleo, eggs, flour, and sugar. Mix well. 2. Add flavoring, nuts, and chips. 3. Pour into unbaked pie shell. 4. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

Name: Custard Pie
Ingredients: 3 eggs; 1/3 C sugar; ¼ t salt; ¼ t nutmeg; 1¾ C milk; 1 t vanilla; 2 t butter; 2 t flour
Instructions: Mix together, bake 350° about 45 min.

Name: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
Ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix; 8 oz. sour cream; 2 c. sugar; 12 oz. frozen coconut, thawed
Instructions: 1. Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Bake in three greased and floured pans. 2. While cake is baking, mix together sour cream and sugar. Be sure sugar is melted in sour cream. 3. Add coconut and stir well. 4. Remove cake from pans as soon as it is done. Pour one third of coconut mixture over each layer.

Name: Perfect Pumpkin Pie
Ingredients: 1 (15-ounce) can pumpkin; 1 (14-ounce) can EAGLE BRAND Sweetened Condensed Milk; 2 eggs; 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon; ½ teaspoon ground ginger; ½ teaspoon ground nutmeg; ½ teaspoon salt; 1 (9-inch) unbaked pie crust
Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. 2. Whisk pumpkin, EAGLE BRAND, eggs, spices and salt in medium bowl until smooth. Pour into crust. 3. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350°F and continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1 inch from crust comes out clean. 4. Cool. Store leftovers covered in refrigerator.

Name: Caramel Chocolate Trifle
Ingredients: 2 packages (3.9 ounces each) chocolate instant pudding mix; 1 carton (12 ounces) frozen whipped topping, thawed; 1 package (9 ounces) devil's food cake mix; 1 jar (12-1/4 ounces) caramel ice cream topping; 1 package toffee bits or almond brickle chips
Instructions: 1. Prepare and bake cake according to package directions for an 8-in. square baking pan. Cool on a wire rack. 2. Prepare pudding according to package directions. 3. Cut cake into 1-1/2-in. cubes; place half in a 3-1/2-qt. trifle bowl or large glass serving bowl with half the whipped topping, pressing down to fill gaps. 4. Repeat layers. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Name: Banana Cream Pie
Ingredients: 1 (14-ounce) can EAGLE BRAND Sweetened Condensed Milk; 1½ cups cold water; 1 (3.9 ounces) package instant banana cream pudding mix; 2 cups whipping cream, whipped; 1 prepared graham cracker or baked pie crust; 3 medium bananas; Lemon juice
Instructions: 1. Dissolve pudding mix in water. Stir in EAGLE BRAND and egg yolks. Cook and stir until thickened. 2. Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla. Cool slightly. 3. Slice 2 bananas; dip in lemon juice and drain. Arrange on bottom of prepared pie crust. 4. Pour filling over bananas; cover. Chill 4 hours or until set. 5. Spread top with whipped cream. Slice remaining banana; dip in lemon juice, drain and garnish top of pie.

Name: Cherry Topped Cheese Cake
Ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs; ½ cup melted butter; 3 – 8 ounce packages cream cheese; 1½ cups sugar; 5 eggs; 3 tablespoons lemon juice; 1 can cherry pie filling
Instructions: 1. Mix crumbs and butter together and press in bottom of spring form pan. 2. Beat cream cheese and sugar til fluffy then add 1 egg at a time beating good after each. 3. With a spoon, stir in lemon juice. 4. Pour over crumbs and bake at 350 degrees til set. 5. Cool completely and top with cherry pie filling. Refrigerate.
Notes: You need to watch this. It takes a good while to cook. When it begins to look dry and doesn't shake when you touch it, it is done.

Name: Mitch Land's Lemon Icebox Cake
Ingredients: 1 lemon cake mix; 2 cans Eagle Brand (sweetened condensed); ½ c. pure lemon juice; 1 small Cool Whip
Instructions: 1. Cook cake as directed on box. It needs to be a 2 layer, then split to make 4 layers. 2. Mix sweetened condensed milk and juice. Beat until thick and spread on layers. 3. Set aside 1 cup of mixture to beat into Cool Whip and spread all over top and sides of cake. 4. Keep refrigerated.

Name: Paula's Loaded Oatmeal Cookies
Ingredients: ½ cup (1 stick) butter, softened; ½ cup vegetable shortening; 1½ cups packed light brown sugar; 2 eggs; ½ cup buttermilk; 1¾ cups all-purpose flour; 1 teaspoon baking soda; ½ teaspoon salt; 1 teaspoon baking powder; 1 teaspoon ground ginger; 1 teaspoon freshly ground nutmeg; 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon; ¼ teaspoon ground cloves; ½ teaspoon ground allspice; 2½ cups quick-cooking oatmeal; 1 cup raisins; 1½ cups chopped walnuts; 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease cookie sheets. 2. Using electric mixer, cream together butter, shortening, and sugar until fluffy. 3. Add eggs and beat until mixture is light in color. Add buttermilk. 4. Sift together flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, and spices; stir into creamed mixture. 5. Fold in oatmeal, raisins, walnuts, and vanilla, blending well. 6. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes. 7. Drizzle with Brown Butter Icing.
Notes: Brown Butter Icing: Heat ½ cup butter until golden brown. Stir in 3 cups sifted powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Add 3-4 tablespoons water to make drizzling consistency. Makes enough to ice 5 dozen cookies.

Name: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
Ingredients: 2 Cups Butter; 2 Cups Sugar; 2 Cups Brown Sugar; 4 eggs; 5 cups Blended Oatmeal; 2 tsp vanilla; 4 Cups flour; 1 t salt; 2 t Baking powder (if using self-rising flour don't use); 2 t Baking soda; 24 oz chocolate chips; 1 (8 oz) Hershey Bar grated; 3 cups chopped nuts (pecan)
Instructions: 1. Measure & blend oatmeal in blender to fine grains. 2. Cream butter & sugar (both). 3. Add eggs & vanilla, mix. 4. Add flour, oatmeal, salt, soda, baking powder. 5. Add chips & candy & nuts. 6. Roll into balls, place on ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. 7. Bake at 375°.

Name: Banana Cake
Ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Butter cake mix; 3 large ripe bananas, mashed; 1 c. sugar; ½ stick oleo; Cream cheese icing
Instructions: 1. Go by the box of cake mix for mixing and baking. 2. While the cake is baking, make icing. Mix together in a boiler and cook until thick. 3. Spread on cake while still hot; when cold, ice with cream cheese icing.

Name: Coconut Cake
Ingredients: 1 butter pecan cake mix; 1 c. sweet milk; 1 coconut pecan frosting; 4 eggs
Instructions: Mix according to directions. Add frosting mix last, gently stirring in. Pour into greased Bundt pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes in 350° oven.

Name: Foolproof Chocolate Fudge
Ingredients: 3 cups (18 ounces) semi-sweet chocolate chips; 1 (14-ounce) can EAGLE BRAND Sweetened Condensed Milk; ¼ to ½ cup chopped nuts (optional); 1½ teaspoons vanilla extract; Dash salt
Instructions: 1. In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips with EAGLE BRAND and salt. 2. Remove from heat; stir in nuts (optional) and vanilla. 3. Spread evenly into wax paper lined 8- or 9-inch square pan. 4. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares.

Name: Tea Cakes
Ingredients: 1 cup sugar; 2 eggs; 2 tsp vanilla; 1/3 cup shortening; Flour (enough to make like biscuit)
Instructions: 1. Mix sugar, eggs, vanilla, and shortening together. 2. Add enough flour to make like biscuit. 3. Roll out & cut. 4. Bake 350°.

Name: Magic Cookie Bars
Ingredients: 1½ cups graham cracker crumbs; ½ cup (1 stick) butter or margarine, melted; 1 (14-ounce) can EAGLE BRAND Sweetened Condensed Milk; 2 cups (12 ounces) semi-sweet chocolate chips; 1⅓ cups flaked coconut; 1 cup chopped nuts
Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (325°F for glass baking pan). 2. In small bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and butter; mix well. Press crumb mixture firmly on bottom of 13x9-inch baking pan. 3. Pour EAGLE BRAND evenly over crumb mixture. 4. Layer evenly with remaining ingredients; press down firmly with fork. 5. Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Cut into bars or diamonds.

Name: Five Layer Delight
Source: Annie L. Beard, Capitol Life Club
Ingredients: First Layer: 1 c. plain flour, 1 stick oleo melted, ½ c. nuts chopped; Second Layer: 8 oz. cream cheese whipped, 1 c. powdered sugar, 2 c. Cool Whip; Third Layer: 1 box (3 oz) chocolate pudding; Fourth Layer: 1 box (3 oz) vanilla pudding; Fifth Layer: 1 small Cool Whip, nuts
Instructions: 1. First Layer: Mix well and put into 13x9x2 inch pan. Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes. Cool completely. 2. Second Layer: Beat cream cheese and sugar; fold in Cool Whip. Pour over crust. Let set in refrigerator until set. 3. Third Layer: Mix chocolate pudding as directed. Pour over second layer and let set. 4. Fourth Layer: Mix vanilla pudding as directed. Pour over third layer and let set. 5. Fifth Layer: Cover with Cool Whip and top with nuts.

Name: Pecan Pie Muffins
Ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar; ½ cup all-purpose flour; 1 cup chopped pecans; ⅔ cup butter (No Substitute, Melted); 2 eggs beaten
Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine brown sugar, flour and pecans. Set aside. 2. Combine butter & eggs. Mix well. Stir into flour mixture just until moistened. 3. Fill greased & floured or paper lined miniature muffin pan two-thirds full. 4. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins test done. Cool on wire rack.
Notes: Cook mini ones about 12 to 16 min

Name: Lemon Delight
Ingredients: ¾ c lemon juice; 3 cans Eagle Brand; 4 egg yolks; 4 T sugar; Graham cracker crust
Instructions: Mix well and pour into graham cracker crust. Let set in refrigerator about 30 minutes.

Name: Date Nut Balls
Ingredients: 1 stick butter; 1 egg beaten; 1 cup sugar; 1 (8oz) chopped dates; 1 cup nuts; 4 cups rice Krispies; 1 tsp vanilla; dash salt; Coconut for rolling
Instructions: 1. Cook slowly until dissolved: eggs, sugar, dates & butter. 2. Add nuts, cook 10 minutes. 3. Remove from heat. 4. Add: vanilla, rice Krispies, salt. 5. Mix everything together & make balls, roll in coconut.

Name: Layered Lemon Dessert
Ingredients: First Layer: 1 cup plain flour, 1 stick butter melted, ½ cup finely chopped nuts; Second Layer: 8 oz. cream cheese, 1 cup powdered sugar, 2 cups cool whip; Third Layer: ¾ cup Lemon Juice, 3 cans Eagle Brand, 6 egg yolks (large), 6 Tbs sugar; Topping: remaining cool whip + nuts
Instructions: 1. First Layer: Mix and bake @ 350° for 15 min or light brown; must be cool before doing next layer. 2. Second Layer: Beat cream cheese and sugar then add cool whip. Pour over crust. Let set in refrigerator until set. 3. Third Layer: Mix ingredients and pour over second layer. 4. Top with remaining whip and nuts.

Name: Peppermint Delight
Ingredients: 36 large or 1 pkg. small marshmallows; 20 small sticks peppermint candy; 3 half-pints whipping cream; 1 c. chopped pecans; 1 lb. vanilla wafers (2 small boxes); Dash of salt
Instructions: 1. Cut large marshmallows into small pieces (if small ones are used, do not cut). Crush peppermint candy finely. 2. Whip cream. Fold marshmallows, candy and nuts into whipped cream. Add a dash of salt. 3. Crush vanilla wafers. Pour ½ of the wafers in bottom of 8x12 inch pan. 4. Pour in mixture and top with remaining vanilla wafers. 5. Put in refrigerator overnight. Cut in squares and serve.

Name: Chess Squares
Ingredients: 1 box powdered sugar; 1 stick oleo (melted); 1 box yellow cake mix; 1 (8-oz.) pkg. cream cheese; 4 eggs; 1 tsp. vanilla
Instructions: 1. Mix oleo, cake mix and 1 egg. Press into a 9x13x2-inch pan. 2. Cream, until fluffy, the cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla and 3 eggs. Pour over crumb crust. 3. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes until golden brown. 4. Cool and cut into squares.

Name: Vanilla Ice Cream
Ingredients: 3 cans pet milk; 2 cans water; 6 eggs; 2 C sugar; 2 T vanilla
Instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze in ice cream maker.

Name: Lemon Blossoms
Ingredients: 18 1/2-ounce package yellow cake mix; 3 1/2-ounce package instant lemon pudding mix; 4 large eggs; ¾ cup vegetable oil; Glaze: 4 cups confectioners' sugar, ⅓ cup fresh lemon juice, 1 lemon zested, 3 tablespoons vegetable oil, 3 tablespoons water
Instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Spray miniature muffin tins with cooking spray. 2. Combine the cake mix, pudding mix, eggs and oil and blend well with an electric mixer until smooth, about 2 minutes. 3. Pour a small amount of batter, filling each muffin tin half way. Bake for 12 minutes. Turn out onto a tea towel. 4. For glaze: Sift the sugar into a mixing bowl. Add the lemon juice, zest, oil, and water. Mix until smooth. 5. Dip the cupcakes into the glaze while they're still warm, covering as much of the cake as possible. 6. Place on wire racks with waxed paper underneath. Let the glaze set thoroughly, about 1 hour.

Name: Nanny's Caramel Icing
Ingredients: ½ cup sugar (in a skillet); 2 cups sugar (in a pot); ½ cup pet milk; 1½ stick Butter
Instructions: 1. Turn both burners on at the same time. 2. When the sugar in the skillet gets brown, put the stuff out of pot in skillet while stirring. 3. Take off burner and let cool. 4. Then beat until spreading consistency.

Name: Holiday Eggnog
Ingredients: 6 eggs; 1 can condensed milk; 1 tsp vanilla; 1 qt milk; ½ pt whipping cream; dash salt; nut meg
Instructions: Beat eggs, mix both milks, vanilla, salt. Fold in whipping cream & sprinkle with nut meg.

Name: Mama's Eggnog
Ingredients: Milk ¾ gal; Eggs 6; Sugar 2½ cups; Vanilla 2 tablespoon; Nut meg (sprinkle on top); Booze extra (optional) - can use vanilla or rum flavoring instead
Instructions: 1. Mix milk, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla. (Be sure to taste for sweet). 2. Beat egg whites until peak. 3. Add to milk mixture. 4. Sprinkle nut meg on top.

Name: Butter Roll
Ingredients: 3 c flour; 1 stick butter; Cinnamon; 1 c sugar; Milk (cover rolls til float); 1 t vanilla; Pats of butter
Instructions: 1. Mix water with flour (like biscuits). 2. Roll out flat like pie crust. 3. Sprinkle cinnamon, sugar, & pats of butter. 4. Roll like jelly roll, slice, place in buttered dish. 5. Mix sugar, milk, vanilla together then pour over rolls. 6. Add butter then Bake.

Name: Homemade Pineapple Blueberry Muffins
Ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour; ⅔ cup sugar; 1 cup Eagle milk; ⅔ cup blueberries; ½ cup fresh crushed pineapple
Instructions: 1. In large bowl, combine flour and sugar. 2. In another bowl, mix egg with Eagle and add milk. Mix well with a fork, then pour into dry ingredients + blueberries. 3. Spoon into greased muffin pans. 4. Preheat oven to 400°. 5. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

Name: Peanut Butter Frosting
Ingredients: 4 T peanut butter; 2 C sugar; 1 stick Butter; 1 C milk
Instructions: 1. Beat ingredients together. 2. Cook until smooth, 10 or 15 minutes (ball stage). 3. Test by dropping in cold water.

Name: Chocolate Ice Cream
Ingredients: ½ gal chocolate milk; 1 can Eagle Brand; 8 oz cool whip
Instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze in ice cream maker.
